title: How the ticket-based taxi dance worked
summary: Humphrey explains the dance-hall ticket system, dime dances and how the girls were paid, and the two-year job.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played
